_note: Independent re-examination of TWO repair efforts that landed on 2026-09-13 and that neither producer has had re-examined: OBJECT A = BATCH_20260913_004, the orchestrator's own 15 canonical edits (commit 04bbde8, verification record 0b5baa0); OBJECT B = ALDAZ-LEDGER-REPAIR-A-20260913, scientist-a's 19 non-canonical repairs (commit ce6dad4, dispositions record disease-models/wwox/research/2026-09-13_aldaz_ledger_repair_dispositions.md). This actor produced neither object, which is the reason it is the one judging them.
OBJECTIVE: Judge both repair objects against the SOURCES: is every repaired sentence true; did either repair delete a true statement or silently narrow one; is any false clause left standing wrapped in quotation or attribution (repair-by-quotation); are the preservation targets intact; did either introduce a refused word or let a reader infer residual binding for the WW1-only construct or say PPxY where only PPPY was assayed. Then run a sweep wider than either producer's over all of disease-models/wwox/, judge discovery_ledger_current.md ~2303 specifically, and report whether the two objects are mutually consistent.
WHY_IT_IS_ON_THE_CRITICAL_PATH: A repair that is not re-examined stays unverified, and that rule does not exempt the integrator. Both objects touch the wording of two claims withdrawn by evidence on the same day; the mandate cannot close while the canonical registries and the non-canonical ledgers may still disagree about P47T in different terms.
THE_RULE_THAT_GOVERNS_THIS_TASK: 🔴 If a defect is found, the finding is checked against the SOURCE before it is reported. A true statement is never called for deletion in order to obey a verification error. An under-claim is a defect exactly as an over-claim is: this repository treats a silent narrowing as the compounding loss. Anything unresolved is reported as DISAGREEMENT_UNRESOLVED with what would resolve it. If a check returns EMPTY, the pattern is suspected before the text is concluded absent — in this batch three exact-phrase greps and one grep -c produced false negatives on text that existed.
ORDER_OF_WORK_THAT_IS_THE_CONTROL: STAGE 1 forms expectations from the sources ALONE (fulltext_dossiers/PMID36828035.md, fulltext_dossiers/PMID24369382.md, commit_candidates/CC-20260913-24369382-02.md, CLAIM 007 and CLAIM 030 as they now stand) and records them as EXPECTATIONS_FORMED_BEFORE_READING_THE_REPAIRS before either producer's account is opened. STAGE 2 judges OBJECT A's 15 canonical edits. STAGE 3 judges OBJECT B's 19 repairs and only THEN reads its disposition record, reporting whether the record matches what was found. The order is not reorderable: a re-examiner who reads the producer's reasoning first reconstructs its intent instead of testing its result.

SUBSTANCE_AT_ISSUE.abundance: Protein PRESENT, abundance NOT QUANTIFIED. Mouse: an unquantified n=2 input lane, mutant bands measurably weaker. Human: ONE individual (Patient II-3, Family 1), three passages of one culture against four controls, by declared 'visual inspection', no densitometry, no statistic.
SUBSTANCE_AT_ISSUE.binding: Severely impaired / near-abolished to the PPPY peptide(s) assayed; faint residual ~3-13% of wild-type integrated density. ONLY PPPY was ever assayed — the 'PPxY motif family' generalisation is the ORIGINAL AUTHORS' caption wording, not the data.
SUBSTANCE_AT_ISSUE.never_conflate: P47T PATIENTS are SCAR12-mild; the P47T MOUSE is severe.
SUBSTANCE_AT_ISSUE.sentence_that_must_survive: Direction unchanged: P47T severely impairs binding to the PPPY peptide assayed — the closing sentence of the blind R4's boundary wording, which is TRUE.

TASK_ACK.governing_rule_accepted: A defect is checked against the source before it is reported; no true statement is called for deletion to satisfy a check; an under-claim is a defect exactly as an over-claim is; DISAGREEMENT_UNRESOLVED is a legitimate outcome; an EMPTY grep is a suspect pattern before it is an absent text.
disclosed_bias: Toward finding a defect, because a re-examination that confirms everything reads as though it did no work — which is exactly the pressure that manufactures a false positive against a true sentence.

Toward deference on OBJECT A, because its producer is the orchestrator that dispatched me and wrote the contract I am judging against; the contract itself names a fourteenth-site problem as the orchestrator's own, so deference here is a failure mode, not politeness.
Toward severity on OBJECT B, because it is a peer's work and the cheapest way to look independent is to be harder on the peer than on the dispatcher.
TASK_ACK.contamination_disclosed_at_ACK: While establishing the Annex C.2 record format I read the first ~60 lines of disease-models/wwox/research/verifications/2026-09-13_aldaz_a2_reexamination.md — scientist-c's re-examination of a DIFFERENT repair object (ALDAZ-RESIDUAL-A2) — and those lines include that actor's own Stage-1 expectations on P47T abundance. This was before my own expectations were formed, so my Stage 1 is not fully uncontaminated by a peer's framing. I stopped reading at that point. The mitigation, and its limit, are recorded in the report: my expectations are derived and quoted from the sources themselves, and anywhere they coincide with that peer's wording I say so rather than presenting the agreement as independent corroboration.
TASK_ACK.note: Accepted as dispatched. No CHALLENGE raised. The contract's own admission that its site list was short by six is treated as evidence about the contract, not as a reason to trust its remaining boundaries: the sweep is run independently of both site lists.

REEXAM_RESULT.OBJECT_A_VERDICT: REFINED — 13 of 15 edits CORRECT (two exemplary), 2 CORRECT_WITH_QUALIFICATION, and 2 residual LIVE over-claims found inside two entries it was itself repairing. The P47T wording is correctly and completely closed in the canonical registries; both defects are on the neuroinflammation axis and neither is a P47T-wording site.
REEXAM_RESULT.OBJECT_B_VERDICT: CONFIRMED — no defect found on the available evidence across all 19 sites, the 16 deliberately-not-touched dispositions and all four preservation targets. One terminological inconsistency, not a defect. Its dispositions record matches what I found on every site I checked.
REEXAM_RESULT.MUTUAL_CONSISTENCY: CONSISTENT — canonical registries and non-canonical ledgers now say the same thing about P47T in substantially the same terms (protein PRESENT, abundance NOT DETERMINED, binding to the PPPY peptide SEVERELY IMPAIRED, only PPPY assayed, mild IN PATIENTS). One function is spelled three ways (CLAIM 030 'WW1 (classe di motivi PPxY; solo PPPY saggiato)' · discovery_ledger:1115 'WW1/PPPY' · discovery_ledger:678 'WW1/PPxY-binding'); none is false, so this is a consistency finding and not a defect. CLAIM 030's scope-marked form is the one to propagate.
REEXAM_RESULT.SITE_2303_VERDICT: CORRECT — a genuine counterfactual, not a disguised assertion, and the producer's defence holds for a better reason than the one offered: the grammatical subject is the instrument rather than the protein; the sentence declares its own output WRONG in the same clause ('sarebbe sbagliato in entrambi i casi'), so it is self-refuting as an abundance claim; and its truth conditions require only that an abundance-reading instrument FAILS TO FLAG P47T, which follows from protein being present with nothing numeric on the panel — the weaker the abundance evidence, the truer the sentence. My pre-stated prior that 'would' is necessary but NOT sufficient was upheld: sufficiency came from the self-refutation clause and the narrowing note above it. One optional hardening offered ('non affetto' / 'normale per abbondanza'); deletion explicitly NOT called for.
REEXAM_RESULT.TWENTIETH_SITE: YES — two, both OBJECT A's, neither a P47T-wording site: (1) discovery_ledger:124 DL-REPO-002 'Evidenza' still asserts 'robusto e multi-tessuto' and 'direzione univoca', one line below OBJECT A's own repair and contradicting the same commit's DL-MECH-012 Belief ('non univoca'; multi-tessuto 'ritirata come argomento di forza'); (2) discovery_ledger:208 DL-MECH-012 'L'indizio' opens on 'in tutti i tessuti la perdita di WWOX aumenta l'infiammazione' — a line OBJECT A edited — contradicted by the fourth peer-reviewed leg (PMID 33058734, BALF null twice) that the same entry now records. On the P47T wording itself my wider sweep found NO twentieth site, which is a positive result for OBJECT B's enumeration.
REEXAM_RESULT.WHY_BOTH_SWEEPS_MISSED_THEM: Both sweeps were keyed to P47T wording — abundance-normality and binding-absoluteness spellings. Neither site contains a P47T abundance or binding word. Mine reached them only because I also swept for internal contradiction between a repaired field and its unrepaired neighbours. The generalisable finding: a field-level repair needs a NEIGHBOUR check, not only a spelling sweep.
REEXAM_RESULT.PRESERVATION: All four targets INTACT. DL-MECH-033 allelic table: six rows, same order, same severity ordering, non-P47T rows byte-identical — confirmed INDEPENDENTLY by diffing the whole day over the file and filtering table rows (exactly two rows changed in 04bbde8~1..HEAD, both P47T cells). FM-016 keeps its finding, STRENGTHENED by the P47T/P47R contrast, and its ^fm-016 anchor is present. The retractions at ~351 and in analysis/proteostasis_rationale.md both rest on the DOMAIN argument (WW1 lesion vs buried SDR missense) and are now independent of the abundance question. CLAIM 030 keeps its five limbs, their order and the MILD/MILD/SEVERE ordering.
REEXAM_RESULT.REFUSED_WORDS_AND_REPAIR_BY_QUOTATION: No instance of 'retains', 'residual recovery' or 'recupero residuo' applied to P47T binding in either object. No site lets a reader infer the WW1-only construct retains residual binding: the only place that measurement appears (M4B section C) carries the saturated-smear/flare caveat and the 'in either direction is the reader's addition' clause in the same bullet. 'PPxY' survives only where scope-marked or attributed. The R4's closing direction sentence survives verbatim. Repair-by-quotation checked at every site: PAPER 042's retained author quotations are NOT repair-by-quotation (scope travels in the same sentence group and the record's own assertion is now 'l'abbondanza non è quantificata'), but a one-clause hardening placed BEFORE the quotations is proposed; the PMID42128308 line 136 quotation and the DL-BIO-085 authors' PPXY quotation are protected class (c) and correctly byte-unchanged.
